annotations.text: Restructure per SRC-041 / WO-083: ten bands down to seven, ~5.4k px instead of ~7.6k. The three concept bands ("The problem", "The loop", "Why not prompt harder?") are replaced by the hero demo — the loop is experienced, not narrated three times.

Hero micro-demo is a working miniature of the real app (tokens + anatomy from packages/ui/renderer/styles.css):
· switch WO / REQ / DEC tabs
· Start agent session → package fetch, DEC-011 filed as proposed, receipt lands
· Promote to active = the approval gate, felt not explained

WO-084: install command form is pending WO-081's distribution DEC — ship whatever lands (npm / brew / npx) and only once it works verbatim on a clean machine. DMG stays the secondary path. Non-Mac sentence sits in the hero sub-line AND the quickstart band.

WO-082: the comparison band names the real incumbent — CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md + ADRs — and states the four differentiators. The 2023 "paste the requirements" strawman is gone; "The problem" band is absorbed here.

Opinion: the site adopts the app's own type — Source Sans 3 + JetBrains Mono — instead of system fonts, so product, site, and docs read as one artifact (and it stops looking like a template). Palette is unchanged site.css canon; both themes ride the existing token blocks. Try the dark/light tweak above each artboard.

Docs keep the same chrome; nav IA is simplified to Docs · GitHub · Download ("Product" anchor and top-level "Workflow" dropped — SRC-041). Docs get copy buttons on code blocks. Fin band adds the missing open-source texture: Apache-2.0, star, sample KB, changelog.
